question_record.context: During a multi-stage security investigation, it was found that a malicious URL (`https://dj01161621.bravesand-e1ccd718.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/`) was clicked on a device named `vnevado-win11h`. The browser process used to access this URL was `msedge.exe` with ProcessId__CreatedTimeUtc__CommandLine `4256__2024-08-01t13:42:52.04__"msedge.exe" --type=utility --utility-sub-type=network.mojom.networkservice --lang=en-us --service-sandbox-type=none --field-trial-handle=1912,i,9358546549091360037,1317674413260171076,262144 --variations-seed-version --mojo-platform-channel-handle=3124 /prefetch:11`. The device has an AadDeviceId `76707c40-3343-490e-9205-88fdb51aefe0` and an IP address `172.33.118.200`.
question_record.question: A related alert indicates suspicious Azure Resource Management (ARM) activities by a user. Can you identify the IP address involved in the suspicious ARM activities?
solution: A user with SID `S-1-5-21-1840151686-3534835288-156286563-1127` clicked on a malicious URL.
There are suspicious Azure Resource Management activities by a user from IP address `253.1.244.215`.

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
